name: Hochadir
role: Ice damage dealer that deals Cold Damage, enhances Frost granted by allies, and inflicts Frost on enemies.

frost.description: At 5 stacks, deals [+3% Max HP] Cold Damage (extra damage scaled with the Frost inflicter's Attack). When Frost reaches 5 stacks and deals damage, additionally inflicts Frozen on the target.

frozen.description: Reduces Attack Speed by 50%, and Recharge Speed by 20%.

permafrost.description: Deploying a certain number of Ice or Necrosis heroes can trigger the Elemental Affinity bonus.

inspiration.effect: Reduces the hero's damage taken by 20% when under Control.
When inflicting a debuff, there is a 70% chance of extending its duration by 30%.
Buffs granted with the battle skill cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Frostbite
skills.description: When the hero is alive, extends the duration of Frost granted by allies by 5s. Targets under Frost will now explode in their current position upon death, dealing [+200% Attack] Cold Damage to enemies within range.

skills.name: Frostfall
skills.description: Grants 20% Attack Up on the Frost ally with the highest Attack for 5s, then deals [+360% Attack] Cold Damage to enemies in a designated area, with a 75% chance to inflict Frost for 5s.

skills.name: Frost Reign
skills.description: Has a 50% chance of inflicting Frost on all enemies for 10s. Instantly detonates all enemies under Frost, dealing AOE [+500% Attack] Cold Damage centered on them. Then detonates all enemies under Frozen again, dealing [+500% Attack] Cold Damage.

talentTree.name: Damage Synergy
talentTree.effect: The hero gains 2000 HP and a Damage Aura: All allies deal 6% more damage. The Aura effect doubles for the hero. (Aura effects of the same type do not stack)

options.name: Warheart
options.effect: When dealing damage to targets inflicted with any negative effect, increases damage dealt by 10%.

options.name: Disabling Shock
options.effect: While dealing damage with the ultimate skill, deals additional damage equal to 200 + 200% of the hero's Accuracy when the target is inflicted with negative effects.

options.name: Rising Momentum
options.effect: While dealing damage with the ultimate skill, deals additional damage by 200 + 200% of the hero's Accuracy upon each hit.

options.name: Howling Wind
options.effect: Deals 15% increased damage to enemies with Frost.

options.name: Bitter Frost
options.effect: Inflicting Frost on an enemy has a 50% chance to inflict Frozen on an extra enemy.

options.name: Winter's Bite
options.effect: Increases Accuracy by 50 when inflicting Frost.

options.name: Cold Surge
options.effect: Increases damage dealt by Frost by 20%.

options.name: Glacial Doom
options.effect: After an ultimate skill hits an enemy with Frost, increases the hero's Crit Rate and Crit Damage by 20% for 5s.

options.name: Glacial Touch
options.effect: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Frost for 5s.

options.name: Tornado
options.effect: After inflicting Frost 10 times, deals [+100% Attack] Cold Damage to all enemies. If enemies have Frost, damage increases by 50%.

options.name: Frozen Gale
options.effect: After every 10 basic attacks, the next ultimate skill releases an extra Snowball at the hit target, dealing [+100% Attack] Cold Damage and inflicting Frost for 5s.

options.name: Frozen Wasteland
options.effect: Gains a [+1% Max HP] shield. When it vanishes, inflicts Frost on all enemies, triggering once every 30s.

story.text: The icy blade pierced through Hochadir's helmet. A few icy spikes broke off in the freezing wind, but the curse quickly regrew them. His horse had carried him for a long time, but neither of them knew how much longer they had to go. Hochadir was looking for an island; it was where he had slept for a long time after being brought ashore by his warhorse in Iskalland.

A grim certainty had taken root in Hochadir's heart — his dynasty lay in ruins. Once, he had sailed aboard the Emperor's vessel, bearing the sacred charge to investigate an isle in Iskalland. The mission failed before it truly began. They said a slumbering god dwelled within that fickle island — now submerged, now breaching the waves like a dying leviathan. After months of torment, when hope itself had frozen solid, the mists parted to reveal its jagged silhouette. What fool's errand had they sent him on? This knight, ignorant as a newborn lamb, understood neither the task's grim purpose nor the horrors it would unleash.

Everyone eventually perished, including Hochadir. They screamed in agony as they were corroded by the sea and devoured by the cold, endlessly tormented as they died. The first tsunami carried him away, and Hochadir thus escaped from the island. He remembered clearly that he had refused the god, and lost all his memories as a result. What was it that he had refused? A flash of fear invaded Hochadir's numb thoughts. What exactly had he refused?

playstyle.description: Hochadir extends the duration of an enemy's Frost debuff and increases the Attack of Frost school allies.

recommendedSet.name: Swift Shadow Headgear
recommendedSet.description: The 2-piece effect of Swift Shadow can increase the wearer's Accuracy and Skill Haste, making it suitable for support heroes.

recommendedArtifact.name: Mark of the Ice Calamity
recommendedArtifact.description: Allows Ice Element wearers to stack up Damage Up when inflicting Frost and has a chance of making the Frost inflicted undispellable, suitable for heroes capable of inflicting Frost.

recommendedArtifact.name: Eyeball of the Giant
recommendedArtifact.description: Increases the ultimate skill damage dealt by the wearer, making it suitable for damage dealers specializing in ultimate skills.
